name: Complete Concrete Qld
topline: Slabs, driveways and exposed aggregate · Mon–Sat
areaText: Based in Logan Village and working across Logan and surrounding areas. Jase comes out to quote in person.
metaDesc: Complete Concrete Qld: house and garage slabs, driveways, exposed aggregate and pool surrounds in Logan. 5.0 stars from 31 Google reviews. Call Jase on 0488 977 792.

hero.title: Concrete done properly, from the first pour to the last finish.
hero.lede: Jase and the Complete Concrete crew pour slabs, driveways, exposed aggregate and pool surrounds across Logan. He turns up to quote, replies to messages, and builds to the engineer's specs.

images.heroAlt: Concrete being poured on a job site

servicesSub: From engineered garage slabs to decorative driveways, every job gets the same care.

services.title: House, garage & shed slabs
services.short: Engineered slabs checked against the specs and poured spot on.
services.long: Garage, patio, shed and extension slabs built to the engineer's specifications, with measurements checked carefully before every pour.

services.title: Driveways & exposed aggregate
services.short: New driveways in plain or exposed aggregate finishes.
services.long: New driveways and carports, including exposed aggregate finishes. We can remove the old driveway and garden first, then pour and finish the new one.

services.title: Pool surrounds & paths
services.short: Large outdoor areas and pathways, finished to a high standard.
services.long: Pool surrounds, outdoor entertaining areas and pathways, even on big jobs of 100 square metres and more. The crew works in with your other trades on site.

services.title: Stairs & work pads
services.short: The tricky jobs other concreters won't quote.
services.long: Concrete stairs, work pads and awkward small jobs that other concreters pass on. Jase will come out and quote them properly.

whyText: Customers say Jase was often the only concreter who replied, turned up and quoted. He keeps you posted on dates, and his crew is friendly and hard working.
gallerySub: Slabs, driveways and outdoor areas around Logan.

reviews.text: Jason and his team did an amazing job on the two slabs for our garage and patio. Very professional, carefully checking over the engineers' specs.
He was one of the very few concreters I contacted who bothered to reply, and the only one to turn up and quote the job.
Jase took on my garage extension when others were too busy to quote. The slab had a lot of engineering requirements which he managed with ease.
We are over the moon with the quality of the finish. Our exposed aggregate driveway looks fabulous.
Well over 100m² of concreting to my pool area and pathways. I cannot rate Jason and his team highly enough.
The quote was more than reasonable and the quality of the finished work exceeded my expectations.

faq: Do you come out to quote?
Yes. Jase quotes jobs in person so he can see the site and get the details right.
Can you remove an old driveway first?
Yes. Demolition of the old driveway and removal of gardens can be included.
Do you work to engineering plans?
Yes. Slabs are built to the engineer's specifications and checked before pouring.
